**What I read:**
- `dedupe.py` (the function with the bug)
- `feed.py` (uses `unique()`)
- `keys.py` (defines `norm()` used by `unique()`)
- `test_src.py` (test cases)

**What I did not read or exercise:**
- Any other files in the directory beyond the four listed above
- The behavior of `merge()` in feed.py (I fixed its dependency but didn't test merge itself)
- Edge cases beyond the two test cases provided (empty lists, single items, etc.)
- Performance characteristics or large dataset behavior

Both tests pass: `test_keeps_first_and_order()` and `test_no_duplicates()`.
